units.source_text: 到了十一月，连日雨雪纷飞。

en.t: When November came, rain and snow fell day after day.

units.source_text: 别人家的积雪有时消融，但这里蓬蒿及猪秧秧等长得又高又密，

en.t: At other houses the accumulated snow sometimes melted, but here the mugwort, cleavers, and other weeds grew tall and thick,

units.source_text: 遮住了朝夕的阳光，因此积雪不消，仿佛越国的白山。

en.t: blocking the sunlight morning and evening, so the snow did not melt and looked like the white mountains of Echigo.

units.source_text: 进进出出的仆役也没有，末摘花只得凝望着雪景，枯坐沉思。

en.t: There were no servants coming and going either, so Suetsumuhana could only gaze at the snowy scene and sit there lost in bleak thought.

units.source_text: 侍从在日，还能说东说西，以资慰乐；

en.t: When Jiju was still with her, she could talk about this and that and provide some comfort and amusement;
whether crying or laughing, she helped relieve her loneliness.
Now even that person had gone away.

units.source_text: 一到晚上，她只有钻进灰尘堆积的寝台里，备尝孤眠滋味，独自悲伤而已。

en.t: When night came, she could only crawl into the bedstead piled with dust, taste all the bitterness of sleeping alone, and grieve by herself.
